candidates.priorities_note: Her priorities page lists sections in this order; the top 3 are the first three section headings. (The page was rewritten in October with new sections.)

priorities.heading: Making Northwest Ohio More Affordable
priorities.quote: Marcy is fighting to make life more affordable for working families — taking on the powerful interests driving up the cost of everyday goods, while ending Washington’s corporate welfare that uses taxpayer dollars to bankroll giveaways for Billionaires, big corporations, and the well-connected.

priorities.heading: Jobs/Manufacturing/Labor
priorities.quote: That’s why she’s investing in Northwest Ohio’s workforce – to bring good-paying jobs home, end tax breaks for companies that ship jobs overseas, and expand workforce training so our workers are prepared to thrive in the industries of the future.

priorities.heading: Keeping Northwest Ohio Safe and Secure
priorities.quote: Marcy believes securing our border is a shared American responsibility — one we can solve if we work together to enforce our immigration laws, deport violent criminals, and give law enforcement the resources they need — all while protecting due process, accountability, and the rule of law.

cost-of-living.heading: Making Northwest Ohio More Affordable
cost-of-living.quote: Marcy is fighting to make life more affordable for working families — taking on the powerful interests driving up the cost of everyday goods, while ending Washington’s corporate welfare that uses taxpayer dollars to bankroll giveaways for Billionaires, big corporations, and the well-connected.
cost-of-living.note: Updated Oct 12, 2026: her priorities page was rewritten with new sections.

housing.heading: Making Northwest Ohio More Affordable
housing.quote: Marcy is taking on Billionaire and corporate investors buying up homes and driving up prices while working to expand the supply of affordable housing so more families can put down roots in Northwest Ohio.

health-care.quote: She is fighting to fully fund Medicare and Medicaid, restore Affordable Care Act tax credits, lower prescription drug prices, and protect families from surprise medical bills.
